title: Edit
description: An edit request (apply.patch). This is the trust-spine: payload.undoLabel is MANDATORY and payload.operations MUST be a non-empty array (PROJECT.md / AGENTS.md line 17: 'undo labels mandatory'). Frozen from docs/seed.md §Edit request example + §data model patch operations.
$comment: TRUST-SPINE ENFORCEMENT: payload.undoLabel is non-optional at the schema level — the bridge refuses any edit without it. The operation element discriminated union (midi_velocity_scale, insert_notes, ...) from seed.md §data model (scope/operations/rationale/reversibility/risk) is tightened in Phase 3 (EDIT-01). For the Phase 1 spike we freeze the envelope-level requirement (undoLabel + operations present), not the full operation catalog. D-01's deep-verify of undo behavior informs whether undoLabel is honored natively or only used for daemon-authoritative revert (recorded in bitwig-capabilities.md).

id.description: Edit requests ARE requests — correlation id REQUIRED.

payload.description: Patch payload. undoLabel + operations are both REQUIRED (trust-spine).

undoLabel.description: MANDATORY non-empty undo label. PROJECT.md trust model: every applied patch gets an undo label. Enforced at schema level.

operations.description: Non-empty array of patch operations. Element shapes (midi_velocity_scale, insert_notes, ...) from seed.md §data model; tightened in Phase 3 (EDIT-01). For the spike, freeze the envelope-level requirement (non-empty array), not the element union.
